coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: The output identifies five of nine variable categories at least partially: dataset (WikiText-2), model size (7B/13B), weight precision (W4/2-bit), perplexity, and stability. This gives 56% category-level coverage, although several specifications are incomplete.
coverage.design_error_analysis: It omits the 2048 sequence length, 70B model, explicit 3-bit condition, all four required quantization methods, per-column asymmetric quantization, and the FP16 baseline. Weight-only purity is discussed as a boundary rather than clearly holding inputs and KV caches in FP16. Stability thresholds do not explicitly identify Inf/NaN failures. The restricted cell design and auxiliary zero-shot tasks do not reproduce the required experiment.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty and therefore does not semantically match the ground-truth results.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: It provides neither the expected perplexity results nor the conclusions about QuaRot-GPTQ improvements, low-precision RTN failures, partial RTN stabilization, or the 70B W2 improvement from 25.30 to 5.60.
